briefing: Markets pulled back modestly today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.4%) on no major catalyst — a neutral, low-conviction session. Existing positions were left untouched since none hit stop-loss or profit-target levels, and we deployed a portion of idle cash into KRMN, the highest-scoring candidate, since cash was above the $500 threshold with open slots available.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) bullish crossover happens when a stock's short-term momentum line crosses above its signal line, often signaling the start of an upward trend. It's one of the confirming signals used today to select KRMN, alongside RSI and price-vs-moving-average checks, rather than relying on a single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD（指數平滑異同移動平均線）出現「黃金交叉」，即短期動量線升穿訊號線，通常代表升勢可能展開。今日揀選KRMN時，MACD交叉訊號與RSI及股價相對移動平均線的位置一併考慮，避免只憑單一指標下判斷。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, suggesting a mild rotation away from higher-growth, higher-beta names. There was no single dominant headline driving the move, consistent with a routine consolidation day after recent gains. Overall breadth remained mixed rather than showing broad-based selling pressure.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和回落，納指跌幅大於標普500指數，反映資金略為由高增長、高波動性的股份撤離。今日並無單一重大消息主導市況，較似是近期升勢後的整固日。整體市場廣度參半，未見大規模拋售壓力。

trades.reasoning: Top-scored candidate (95) with RSI in the healthy bullish zone, a confirmed MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, and price above SMA-20, filling an open slot with idle cash above the $500 threshold.
